independentNeed: A coverage assignment must let the business distinguish one activation of one asset under one service contract from later re-activation of the same pair, while keeping implementation row identity and history revision identity separate from the business occurrence.

in: effective-from and effective-to semantics for that activation
history revision identity as a separate concern

teiOriginalDecisions.text: CoverageAssignment is a TEI-original Reference occurrence that associates one independent ServiceContract occurrence with one independent Asset occurrence.
The Reference pressure treats ServiceContract occurrence + Asset occurrence + effectiveFrom as the candidate business occurrence identity, while effectiveTo is not an identity component.
Re-activation of the same ServiceContract and Asset pair at a later effectiveFrom is a separate business occurrence, not a history revision of the earlier assignment.
A history revision identifier is separate from CoverageAssignment business occurrence identity.
Surrogate-primary-key and composite-primary-key persistence realizations must preserve the same Reference business meaning.

proposals.text: Reuse a shared determinant-term vocabulary while keeping occurrence identity, candidate key and functional dependency as separate semantic assertions.
